To visit all 39 locations starting from **The Hub (21)** in an efficient route that minimizes backtracking across the Kenshi map, I recommend following this path. It circles the continent in a roughly clockwise spiral.

### Phase 1: The Local & Northwest Run
Start by clearing the immediate area and heading into the fog and northern coasts.
*   **21 (Start: The Hub)** $\rightarrow$ **19** $\rightarrow$ **20** (Border Zone)
*   Head West to **15** (Vain/Beak Thing territory)
*   Enter the Fog Islands to reach **10** (Mongrel)
*   Exit Northwest to the coast at **9**
*   Head East through the Hidden Forest to **4** $\rightarrow$ **5** (World's End) $\rightarrow$ **2** $\rightarrow$ **6**

### Phase 2: Central Valley and The Great Desert
Drop down into the Holy Nation valley before heading into the United Cities territory.
*   From 6, go South to **11** $\rightarrow$ **14** (Okran's Pride/Blister Hill)
*   Head East past the mountains to **16** (Black Scratch)
*   Go North into the Great Desert: **12** $\rightarrow$ **7** $\rightarrow$ **3** $\rightarrow$ **1** $\rightarrow$ **8** $\rightarrow$ **13** (Heft/Stoat area)

### Phase 3: The Eastern Edge & The Deadlands
Work your way down the dangerous eastern coast and then cut through the center.
*   From 13, go South to **18** $\rightarrow$ **17**
*   Push East into the pits: **24** $\rightarrow$ **25** $\rightarrow$ **26**
*   Head West through the acid rain of the Deadlands: **23** $\rightarrow$ **22** (Black Desert City)

### Phase 4: The South Central & Shem
Head down through the central lakes toward the southern lagoons.
*   From 22, go South to **33** $\rightarrow$ **34** (Shem/Burning Sands)
*   Continue South to **35** $\rightarrow$ **36** (Flat Lagoons)

### Phase 5: The Swamp & The Western Kingdom
Swing back west through the swamps and up into Shek territory.
*   From 36, head West into the Swamp: **32** $\rightarrow$ **31** (Shark)
*   Head North out of the swamp to **29** $\rightarrow$ **28** $\rightarrow$ **27** (Admag)

### Phase 6: The Final Stretch (The Deep South)
Finish by heading down the southwestern coast into the Hook and Royal Valley.
*   From 27, go South to **30** (The Hook)
*   Follow the coast/path southeast to **37** $\rightarrow$ **38** $\rightarrow$ **39**
